import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPowerOpen

/-!
# Sections on open symmetric powers

Pullback along an open immersion identifies sections on its relative-power
image with global sections of the original relative power. Permutation
naturality restricts this identification to the invariant subrings.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction

namespace MilneLib

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
  {V W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
  (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ) [IsOpenImmersion f.left]

/-- The whole relative power is stable under its permutation action. -/
theorem quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ) :
    IsStableOpen (quotientPermutationAction V n) ⊤ := by
  intro g
  simp

/-- The inverse image of the relative-power image is the whole source power. -/
theorem relativePowerMap_preimage_open :
    (relativePowerMap f n).left ⁻¹ᵁ relativePowerMapOpen f n = ⊤ := by
  letI := relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion f n
  exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_opensRange _

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Pullback identifies invariant sections on the relative-power image with
invariant global sections for the actual permutation action on the source. -/
noncomputable def relativePowerMapOpenFixedSectionsEquiv :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction W n)
      (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable V n)
    FixedPoints.subring Γ((relativePower W n).left, relativePowerMapOpen f n)
        (ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) ≃+*
      FixedPoints.subring Γ((relativePower V n).left, ⊤)
        (ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) := by
  letI := relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion f n
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction W n)
    (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction V n)
    (quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable V n)
  let F := (relativePowerMap f n).left
  let U := relativePowerMapOpen f n
  let r := F.appLE U ⊤ (relativePowerMap_preimage_open f n).ge
  haveI : IsIso r := by
    haveI := F.isIso_app U le_rfl
    change IsIso (F.app U ≫ (relativePower V n).left.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (relativePowerMap_preimage_open f n).symm).op)
    infer_instance
  let e := (asIso r).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  refine e.restrict (FixedPoints.subring _ _) (FixedPoints.subring _ _) ?_
  intro s
  change (∀ g : ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
      (actApp (quotientPermutationAction W n)
        (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n) g⁻¹).hom s = s) ↔
    ∀ g : ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
      (actApp (quotientPermutationAction V n)
        (quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable V n) g⁻¹).hom (r.hom s) = r.hom s
  apply forall_congr'
  intro g
  have heq (a : ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) :
      (quotientPermutationAction V n a).hom ≫ F =
        F ≫ (quotientPermutationAction W n a).hom :=
    congrArg (fun t => t.left) (relativePowerMap_perm_naturality f n a.down⁻¹).symm
  have hc := congrArg (fun t => t.hom s)
    (appLE_actApp_of_equivariant (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (quotientPermutationAction W n) F heq (relativePowerMapOpen_isStable f n)
      (quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable V n)
      (relativePowerMap_preimage_open f n).ge g⁻¹)
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact hc.trans (congrArg r.hom hs)
  · intro hs
    exact e.injective (hc.symm.trans hs)

variable [(relativePower W n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower W n).left]
  (h : OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft W n))

/-- The coordinate ring of an open symmetric power is the invariant ring of
global sections on the original source power, under permutation of factors. -/
noncomputable def symmetricPowerQuotientOpenSourceSectionsEquiv :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (quotientPermutationAction_top_isStable V n)
    Γ((symmetricPowerQuotient W n h).left, symmetricPowerQuotientOpen f n h) ≃+*
      FixedPoints.subring Γ((relativePower V n).left, ⊤)
        (ULift.{u} (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) :=
  (symmetricPowerQuotientOpenSectionsEquiv f n h).trans
    (relativePowerMapOpenFixedSectionsEquiv f n)

end MilneLib
